# proxmox_storage_upload (Resource)

Uploads a local file to storage through `POST /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/upload`. The file is read at apply time; changing its content requires a `triggers` change. Destroy deletes the uploaded volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_storage_upload" "seed" {
  node     = "pve"
  storage  = "local"
  content  = "iso"
  source   = "${path.module}/seed.iso"
  triggers = { revision = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `source` (String)
- `storage` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Optional

- `checksum` (String)
- `checksum_algorithm` (String)
- `filename` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
- `volume_id` (String)
